parameters.query:
update clarifications c
set notified_at = now()
from wills w
join leads l on l.id = w.lead_id
where c.will_id = w.id
  and c.status = 'sent'
  and c.notified_at is null
returning
  c.id            as clarification_id,
  c.will_id       as will_id,
  c.message_final as message_final,
  l.full_name     as full_name,
  l.email         as email;

nodes.name: Claim unsent clarifications
nodes.notes: UPDATE ... RETURNING is atomic: it stamps notified_at AND returns the row in one shot, so overlapping runs can never email the same clarification twice. Emits one item per clarification -> the email node runs once each. If nothing is owed, 0 rows and the workflow ends.
